cc:Work.dc:title: Source-defined Nordic section widths
cc:Work.dc:description: Four occupations: 30 Jul / 19 Nov 2016; 8 Mar / 7 Jun 2017. No per-date widths assigned. 20% of maximum depth-integrated relative geostrophic current; surface-pressure reference. Exact width integration depths unspecified. No midpoint, annual extrema or width error inferred. Source: Fer et al. (2020), doi:10.5194/os-16-685-2020, p692 · CC BY 4.0. Norwegian Current catalog-name ambiguity retained. Independent OSW graphic.
